The request is polite and positive in tone (high "warmth"), which aligns with Willet's stated preferences, and it carries none of the harm-adjacent or ethically fraught qualities that Willet reports steep aversion to.

On the capability side, this is a straightforward knowledge/explanation task. Both models are highly capable here, and the relevant eval differences (Support Dialogue, and general knowledge) are either close or not decisive for such a simple, well-understood request. Since neither model has a meaningful quality edge on a query this easy, I routed based on the preference fit — and Willet is the better match for friendly, benign, helpful content.
